title: THUMBS DOWN I recommend do not buy this disappointment
text: THUMBS DOWN I recommend do not buy this disappointment. After much research I purchased the 12 " queen mattress .  I decided on this mattress because of the description, the thousands of exceptional reviews and it is a product sold by Amazon. I am a senior with fibromyalgia. I was excited about getting a mattress that I could get a comfortable, full, good nights sleep on. It was delivered the on the designated date but after the hour of 8 PM. The carrier had dumped it in the middle of my driveway and not on my porch at the front door. This was an omen.  It is very heavy! I had to go out and push it out of the way so my sons could get in the driveway to take it in the house. The box was ripped open and the white plastic bag it is packed in was torn in transit but the mattress was not dirty because of another clear plastic cover.  We followed the directions exactly. It was laid out on the frame to expand.  At 48 hrs it had not risen like it was supposed to have done. ( it does have a strong chemical odor) Okay so I waited and waited. After one week /7 days it had expanded to 8 in to 6 in in one of the corners. I never slept on this nightmare. The sides are collapsed. The top is uneven and lumpy. The mattress is deformed in shape. The corners curl up and do not touch the frame. The top layer of foam is not connected to the rest of the mattress. This product is substandard, inferior, a worthless waste of money. It is defective disaster. I was so looking forward to that cloud that others have in their reviews. This whole experience was a failure and disappointment.  I am still sleepy on a twin foam I have in my guestroom/ office.  BEWARE don't buy this mattress!  All those good reviews don't help you when you get stuck with a cheap piece of junk.

product_metadata.title: ZINUS 12 Inch Cloud Memory Foam Mattress / Pressure Relieving / Bed-in-a-Box / CertiPUR-US Certified, Queen
features: Green Tea and Activcharcoal-infused Memory Foam With a Plush, Microfiber Quilted Jacquard Cover

CLOUDLIKE LUXURY - We’re not kidding - the feel of our Cloud mattress is just how we imagine it would feel to sleep on one; with cradling memory foam and plush microfiber, we’ve created a cloudlike, luxurious feel that hugs your curves like no other

SUPPORTIVE FOAMS - 2 total inches plush microfiber and foam quilted top, 2 inches conforming memory foam, 3 inches soft comfort foam, and 5 inches durable, high density base support foam; ideal for side sleepers and petite to average-weight sleepers
CERTIPUR US CERTIFIED - Highest quality foam is CertiPUR US Certified for durability, performance, and content

EXPERTLY PACKAGED - Our technology allows this mattress to be efficiently compressed into one box that’s easily shipped and maneuvered into the bedroom; simply unbox, unroll and this mattress does the rest, expanding to its original shape within 72 hours
Twin mattress supports a maximum weight of 250 lbs, while all other sizes can support up to 500 lbs
description: We may never know what it’s like to sleep on a cloud, but with the Cloud Memory Foam Mattress we like to think we’re close! We designed it with a plush, quilted cover and a unique combination of foam layers that provide a plush, luxurious feel. This innovative system of layers shapes itself to your body to give you a pressure relieving, customized sleep experience like no other. Providing you with cleaner sleep, it’s specially infused with green tea and natural charcoal for freshness and resistance against odor-causing agents over time. And to top it off, the foam is Certi-PUR US certified. All of this goodness, along with a 10 year worry-free warranty, compressed into one convenient box and shipped right to your door. Thousands of highly satisfied customers agree, until science finds a way to put actual clouds in the bedroom, this mattress will do just fine.
